t: What does it mean to "observe" a quantum system?
e: Reader companion · the measurement problem
d: The measurement problem — physics's name for the question of why looking at a quantum system seems to change it, and what 'looking' even means. The von Neumann chain, Wigner's friend, the 2018 Frauchiger-Renner paradox, and why decoherence resolves the technical problem but leaves the philosophical one open.
s: Reader companion · the measurement problem What does it mean to "observe" a quantum system? Of all the strange things physics has had to absorb in the last hundred years, the strangest is the role of measurement . Quantum systems evolve smoothly and predictably when no one is looking.
